Rule text: L31-15 ring walk: from each abutter on the subject's frontage street, step to the next lot whose frontage street is the subject's; where more than one, the lot with the longest shared edge, lowest lot id on a tie; the ring is a set of distinct lots; a lot with no estimate keeps its place (counts toward depth, not toward the mean). decisions.subject: McProof: the sizing decision is generated: M-445
decisions.recommendation: CARD-mcproof-1-7 (~/Buildo-scratch/p2close/CARD-mcproof-1-7.answered.md). Rule text: The sizing decision is generated, not hand-picked. A generator (`sizing.mjs`) reads the examples, the City approvals and the review records and writes `sizing.json` (path per example with the rule id). "Keep agreeing" = share of agreement between stage 3 and stage 4 >= `agreement_min_share` over >= `agreement_min_sample` fully reviewed examples in the same increment and layer; the sample is chosen by a seeded hash; a miss in a sample puts the layer back to full; Ruling-layer examples are never quick. `sizing.mjs` also writes `low_risk_arithmetic` (v4, CARD-mcproof-lessons item 2). Flipping `quick_arithmetic_skips_stage5` invalidates the `n/a` reasons that cite it; the builder recomputes them (v4.1). All thresholds sit in `mcproof.config.json` with a reason each; changing one is a ruling.

Each stage result carries a model, attempts, an `example_sha` and a `config_sha`; a changed example reads as `open`; `n/a` needs a reason; a crashed stage is `errored` and blocks approval; v4 (CARD-mcproof-lessons item 3; builder sub-item (c)): a stage 3 or stage 5 reply with no answer table (critique only) is `errored`, retried up to `max_retries_per_stage`, and never counts as an answer; still errored after the cap it becomes parked with its reason, listed in the operator summary; a layer label changed after stage 0 changes the `example_sha` and resets that example's stage 0 (v4.1) (evidence `MB-64/review/REVIEW.md:37`, `REVIEW.round2.md:92`, `:98`); `city` is derived from the generator at build time; `overall` is derived; accepted findings are listed with a reason; mandatory stages by layer decide APPROVED; a worked-example edit before the key is signed is logged, after signing it needs a ledger row (queue Process 1: changing a worked example is a ruling).
